eyebrow.tone: warm origin hook with single emoji (e.g. 'How it all started')

headline.tone: personal, energetic, makes you want to read the story

story_paragraphs.tone: 2-3 paragraph strings, each 280 chars; personal voice, not corporate — like a friend telling you

signature.tone: person name + role (e.g. Maya, Founder & Chief Fun Officer)
